## LaunchDiff Safety Checklist

- [ ] No downloaded Launch code is executed.
- [ ] Parser/matching/normalization changes are fixture-backed.
- [ ] Conservative change detection is preserved.
- [ ] No private fixtures, source, URLs, config, diffs, release notes, credentials, cookies, or tokens are committed.
- [ ] Privacy/security docs are updated when behavior changes.
